diffs.diff: header pin 7: part says STEP, datasheet reading says STP
diffs.evidence: Same signal, different spelling. Pololu's #2133 minimal wiring diagram labels the left-column pin below SLEEP as 'STEP' (the order is ENABLE, M0, M1, M2, RESET, SLEEP, STEP, DIR). Some clone silkscreens abbreviate it to 'STP'. The product page says: 'Each pulse to the STEP input corresponds to one microstep'.

diffs.diff: header pin 9: part says VMOT, datasheet reading says FLT
diffs.evidence: In Pololu's #2133 wiring diagram, the right column reads top to bottom: VMOT, GND, B2, B1, A1, A2, FAULT, GND. The first pin on that side is VMOT, with the 100 uF capacitor and the 8.2-45 V motor supply connected to it. The second reading listed this column in a scrambled order.

diffs.diff: header pin 11: part says B2, datasheet reading says 2A
diffs.evidence: In Pololu's #2133 wiring diagram, the right column reads top to bottom: VMOT, GND, B2, B1, A1, A2, FAULT, GND. The third pin is B2 (coil B, green wire). The clone labels '2A/2B' are different names, and the second reading also put them in the wrong position.

diffs.diff: header pin 12: part says B1, datasheet reading says 2B
diffs.evidence: In Pololu's #2133 wiring diagram, the right column reads top to bottom: VMOT, GND, B2, B1, A1, A2, FAULT, GND. The fourth pin is B1, the other wire of coil B.

diffs.diff: header pin 13: part says A1, datasheet reading says 1A
diffs.evidence: In Pololu's #2133 wiring diagram, the right column reads top to bottom: VMOT, GND, B2, B1, A1, A2, FAULT, GND. The fifth pin is A1 (coil A, yellow wire). '1A' is only a different name for the coil A output (AOUT1).

diffs.diff: header pin 14: part says A2, datasheet reading says 1B
diffs.evidence: In Pololu's #2133 wiring diagram, the right column reads top to bottom: VMOT, GND, B2, B1, A1, A2, FAULT, GND. The sixth pin is A2, the other wire of coil A.

diffs.diff: header pin 15: part says FLT, datasheet reading says VMOT
diffs.evidence: In Pololu's #2133 wiring diagram, the right column reads top to bottom: VMOT, GND, B2, B1, A1, A2, FAULT, GND. The second-to-last pin is FAULT. The product page says: 'The pin used to supply logic voltage to the A4988 is used as the DRV8825's FAULT output'. That pin is the A4988's VDD, which sits next to the bottom GND. VMOT is the top pin, not this one.
